slices.title: "Always" as reviewed revocable rule (MCP rows)
slices.summary: An Always choice on an MCP tool approval becomes a proposed rule that the user confirms in settings. Confirming writes a digest-pinned user-scope allow (mcp_tool only, ceiling external_write, never owner_effect); built-in tools never offer Always. Rules expire (90 days default, 365 max), digest drift demotes them to ask, and create, confirm, use and expiry each write a content-free tool_policy_rule_* audit row.
